notes.title: Tower o-ven v1.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Improved visibility of unlock progress.
 Fixed an issue where the BGM filter would sometimes get disabled.
 Fixed an issue where the menu would sometimes transition to the wrong screen under specific circumstances.

notes.title: Tower o-ven v1.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
Added a new UI style.

Added a new type of Floor.

Fixed the behavior when charging a jump on Ice Floor.

Changed so that the Steam language setting is applied on first launch.

notes.title: Tower o-ven v1.0.9 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added new statistics entries.
Changed so that the direction can be changed while charging a jump.
Added Sound Effects for Sticky Floor.
Changed to pause when the controller is disconnected.
Adjusted some key bindings on the leaderboards.

notes.title: Tower o-ven v1.0.8 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Adjusted key bindings.

Changed the Space key from "Confirm" to "Jump."
Added the E key for "Confirm" and the Q key for "Cancel."

Adjusted some Sound Effects.
Adjusted some UI elements.

notes.title: Tower o-ven v1.0.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where high scores were not saved correctly.
Fixed an issue where sounds were not played correctly.
Adjusted the jumping behavior on the emergency stairs.

notes.title: Tower o-ven v1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes: Changed to show bonus score got by escape.

notes.title: Tower o-ven v1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed display of names on leaderboards.
Fixed to save when changing fullscreen with F11 key.

notes.title: Tower o-ven v1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed animation of Fire Floor and Frost Floor stopped when paused.
Improved drawing when scrolling text.

notes.title: Tower o-ven v1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes: Fixed that the leaderboards did not show the lower ranks than the top 10.

notes.title: Tower o-ven v1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes: Fixed error when escaping on Emergency Exit Floor.

notes.title: "Tower o-ven" Release!
notes.notes:
"Tower o-ven” has been released!
Our goal was to release the product by the end of 2024, but this release has been delayed a bit.
We apologize to those of you who have been waiting.

If you enjoy it, we hope you will write us a review!

Most recently, we plan to fix minor bugs and make improvements to make the game more comfortable to play.
Please check X for updates and progress.
